name: Love Letter
summary: A social deduction card game where suitors use intermediaries to deliver a love letter to the princess.
rules_text: Love Letter uses 16 cards ranked 1 Guard to 8 Princess with special effects. Shuffle the deck and burn one card face down unseen. In 2 players also reveal 3 cards face up as out of play. Each player gets one hidden card. On your turn draw one card then choose and discard one of your two cards face up in front of you, applying its effect even if harmful. Guard guesses an opponent's hand, Priest looks at a hand, Baron compares hands to eliminate loser, Handmaid protects you, Prince makes a player discard, King trades hands, Countess must be discarded if you also hold King or Prince, Princess eliminates you if discarded. If eliminated, reveal hand without effect. Round ends when one player remains or deck empties; then remaining players compare hands, highest wins tie by sum of discards. Winner gains a token of affection, and first player next round is previous winner. First game player is who was most recently on a date. First to 7 tokens in 2p, 5 in 3p, 4 in 4p wins.
rating_reason: Hidden hands, elimination, deduction classic fits engine perfectly
